description: List tax lots, one page at a time. Use this to find the lot id, target key, anchor transfer, or transfer id an assertion needs to name.

maxCostBasis.description: Inclusive upper bound on cost basis, in USD

maxRemaining.description: Inclusive upper bound on remaining quantity, in whole tokens

maxUnitCost.description: Inclusive upper bound on cost per whole token, in USD

minCostBasis.description: Inclusive lower bound on cost basis, in USD

minRemaining.description: Inclusive lower bound on remaining quantity, in whole tokens

minUnitCost.description: Inclusive lower bound on cost per whole token, in USD

openAsOf.description: Read open inventory as of this instant. ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

startDate.description: Only lots acquired at or after this instant. ISO 8601.

status.description: Which lots to include. Defaults to open.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounting_lots_list
